title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 5–11 years (¥650bn anticipated) — the JGB family's only high-n instrument, and the control that reads the super-long auction's zero-20-year result
source: EST: mof.go.jp English October 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2610e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 24,854 bytes) for this initial research; its table row reads 'Oct. 22, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 5-11 years)'. The DATE is MOF's own. The ¥650bn SIZE is anticipated, not announced: NO October row carries an announcement href on 2026-09-09, and MOF's note reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms ~2026-10-15. The anticipated size is the strongest prior on this calendar — MOF's own announcement pages print 'Offering Amount | About 650 billion yen' for TWENTY-FIVE CONSECUTIVE auctions, 2024-08-22 through 2026-08-26 (auct20240815e … auct20260819e, each HTTP 200, fetched direct 2026-09-09), after a ¥500bn → ¥600bn → ¥650bn ramp across the first seven. CADENCE IS MONTHLY AND UNBROKEN ACROSS A ZONE REDEFINITION: MOF's own consecutive monthly calendars 2401e → 2611e (35 slates, all HTTP 200; 2612e 404s, not yet published) place a mid-zone Liquidity Enhancement Auction in EVERY ONE of the 35 months 2024-01 → 2026-11 with no exception, labelled '5-15.5 years' through 2026-03-09 and '5-11 years' from 2026-04-16. It is the only one of the three zones that never skips a month — the super-long zone runs even months only, the 1-5y zone odd months only. Filed `estimate` on three counts: the size is anticipated rather than announced, the reopened-issue list does not exist until MOF's own 'Issues Re-opened' page publishes on the day, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Proposed 2026-09-09 by the jgb-liquidity-enhancement-11-39y-2026-10-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (proposals/jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-10-22.from-jgb-liquidity-enhancement-11-39y-2026-10-27.json, read as input and now shadowed by this canonical file); researched 2026-09-09 (docs/research/events/jgb-liquidity-enhancement-5-11y-2026-10-22.md). THE FALSIFIER IT WAS PROPOSED AS CANNOT WORK AS POSED, AND WHAT REPLACES IT IS SHARPER. The super-long ledger asked whether its zero-20-year result meant the paper was 'clearing in the neighbouring zone'. MOF's own announcements say the two zones SHARE NO BONDS at any date — mid holds 20Y No.130-161 and 30Y No.6-26, super-long holds 20Y No.162-196, 30Y No.27-90 and 40Y No.1-18 — so a 20-year issue refused at 11-39y is not eligible at 5-11y and cannot clear there. THE APRIL 2026 REDEFINITION SUPPLIED A BETTER TEST, A CONTROLLED ONE. It moved two blocks out of this zone and into the super-long auction: 20-year No.161-177 (¥5.7tn, 10.7-14.7y remaining, weighted-average coupon 0.47%) and 30-year No.27-34 (¥1.6tn, 10.9-14.4y remaining, weighted-average coupon 2.26%). Same auction, same day, same bidders, same ¥250bn constraint, OVERLAPPING REMAINING MATURITIES. The super-long auction then took the 30-year block at 33.4% / 45.2% / 15.5% of its whole size and the 20-year block at 0.0% / 0.0% / 0.0%. The sibling's headline is therefore NOT a tenor or curve-segmentation signal — it is a COUPON/VINTAGE signal, and this zone's own 32-print record says the same thing monotonically: takeup versus eligible-stock share runs 0.62x for 10-year paper (0.87% average coupon), 1.32x for 20-year (1.26%) and 1.86x for 30-year (2.26%), all at matched 5-11y remaining maturity, with the last five auctions at 0.36x / 1.58x / 5.05x. IT IS ALSO THE FAMILY'S ONLY HIGH-N JGB INSTRUMENT — 32 prints, against n=3 at the super-long, which is where the sibling's 'compute the tenor's own distribution first' rule ran out of road. AND MOF MOVED THE TWO ZONES IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS: this one ¥500bn → ¥650bn (+30%) while the super-long was cut ¥450bn → ¥250bn (-44%), which is why the super-long's cover trap does not transfer — size here has been constant for 25 prints, so cover is readable directly. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure, no house playbook is rates-keyed, and this zone's own curve segment is unremarkable (5s10s +63.8bp, 62.3rd percentile of 8,594 sessions) against the super-long's 93.5th/1.2nd extremes. The auction sits two days after jgb-20y-auction-2026-10-20 and five before jgb-liquidity-enhancement-11-39y-2026-10-27, and shares its date with treasury-5y-tips-2026-10-22 and treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-10-22. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
